name: Mnemoverse
description: Hosted persistent memory for agents: save decisions, preferences and lessons, then recall them in later conversations and in other MCP clients.
notes: Connects to the hosted endpoint https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp over streamable HTTP with a Mnemoverse API key sent as a bearer token, so nothing runs inside the sandbox. Memory is kept by the hosted Mnemoverse service, not in the sandbox, so it carries over to conversations that start in a fresh runtime. Memory is scoped to the Mnemoverse account, so other MCP clients connected to the same account reach the same memory. Rating a recalled memory as helpful or misleading re-ranks what comes back next.

auth.credentialHelp: Create a key in the [Mnemoverse console](https://console.mnemoverse.com/sign-up); the free plan needs no credit card. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

installHint: Create a free account at console.mnemoverse.com (no credit card) and paste an API key that starts with mk_live_. It is sent to the hosted endpoint as a bearer token.
